svg.title: MP SHOOT — Floor 4 architectural plan, first draft
svg.desc: One northwest arrival and return elevator connects reception, review offices, corrections, evidence, records, conference and a restricted senior suite. Gold access is reserved for the Crime Reader boss office. Proposed corruption is confined to late-stage annotations.
svg.text: A3 LANDSCAPE / 1:250 AT ORIGINAL PRINT SIZE
After boss: release the SAME elevator
12: return to cabin / descend to Floor 5
Hatching is a reservation, not a hazard
Keep the marked dodge circuit clear
Wall centres shown; wall t = 0.24 m
Room dimensions are to wall centres
Envelope: 73.4 × 53.6 m · Enclosed layout: 2,806 m² incl. circulation / service riser · Irregular perimeter
First architectural draft only. Existing Floors 1–3 remain unchanged. Boss mechanics / corruption effects are future implementation work.
